caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, patterned clouds, a fierce crowned guardian deity seated within a ring of flame scrolls on a deep blue ground, small attendant figures below and a lotus throne behind, lapis blue, cinnabar red, malachite green, ochre, gold
